 Live Blog: 2026 WNBA Finals - Game 4
 WNBA.com Staff Follow along with Game 4 of the 2026 WNBA Finals with our live blog! Download the WNBA App for game highlights and exclusive behind-the-scenes footage. 
 October 24 / 2:04 pm ET
 Back on the Run 🏃‍♀️
 Golden State is on a 14-2 run over the last three minutes of the second quarter, extending its lead to 16 points.
 October 24 / 1:57 pm ET
 Three the Hard Way 💪
 Cecilia Zandalasini takes it right to the rack for the three-point play to open Golden State’s lead up to nine points.
 October 24 / 1:50 pm ET
 Dream on the Hunt 👀
 Atlanta is chiseling away at its deficit as Angel Reese scores her first bucket of the day in the second quarter.
 October 24 / 1:41 pm ET
 End of 1Q ✅
 The Valkyries lead 16-11 to close out the first quarter.
 October 24 / 1:31 pm ET
 Valkyries are Rolling ⚔️
 Golden State comes out with hard-nosed defense for an early 12-0 run with 2:30 remaining in the first quarter.
 October 24 / 1:20 pm ET
 First Bucket of the Day 🪣
 And we’re off! Golden State’s Kaila Charles records the first shot of the day.
 October 24 / 1:o0 pm ET
 Game Day in the A ☀️
 We’re live from Atlanta for Game 4 of the best-of-seven Finals series between the Dream and Valkyries! Will Golden State head back to the Bay with a series tie, or will Atlanta go into Game 5 with a towering 3-1 lead?
 Game 4 in the A 📸
 Pregame scenes from Atlanta as the @AtlantaDream look to build on their series lead!
 📺 1pm/ET | NBC & Peacock | #WNBASeason30 | #2026WNBAFinals pic.twitter.com/MY6gYOTKxg
